frozen_manifest_row.user: Describe the main scene and what the visible subjects are doing. Use one sentence.

original_train_description.description: A dark red rusted octagon sign with a white border is connected to a square metal black pole and in the middle of the sign, in white text, is "STOP." On the bottom of the white boarder is a rust color. At the base of the pole is a concrete block, and it sits on a patch of green grass. The shadow of the black pole is partially cast onto the concrete block to the left of the pole. A grey concrete sidewalk is behind the sign and connects to the grass patch in the foreground. Four square wooden poles with a brown and black trashcan in the middle of them are to the back left of the sign sitting in a grass field.

helper.source_excerpt:
def first_caption_sentence(description):
    return re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", description.strip(), maxsplit=1)[0]

explanation: The period in STOP. is followed by a closing double quote, not whitespace, so the existing regex skips that sentence boundary and cuts after the following rust-color sentence.
